meta.name: keyword-research
meta.description: Discover, analyze, and prioritize keywords for SEO and GEO content strategies from a seed keyword or niche. Identifies high-value opportunities based on search volume, competition, intent, and business relevance. Generates topic clusters. For building a dated editorial calendar from your own Search Console data, use `content-planner` instead — this skill is seed-driven keyword discovery, not calendar scheduling. Use when asked to "find keywords", "keyword research", "keyword analysis", "search volume", "keyword difficulty", "content ideas from a seed", or any keyword discovery task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从种子词发现高价值关键词和话题集群
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为网站或内容找到有搜索量的关键词
copy.tagline_en: Discover high-value keywords and topic clusters from a seed term
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find searchable keywords for your website or content

howto.what: Claude 会根据你提供的种子关键词或领域，生成关键词列表、按搜索意图分类、评估竞争难度、计算机会得分，并整理成主题集群和报告。
howto.when: 当你要求“找关键词”、“关键词研究”、“搜索量”、“关键词难度”或“从种子词获取内容创意”等时触发。

say.text: 帮我研究“项目管理软件”的关键词机会。
say.note: Claude 会生成关键词列表、意图分类和难度评估。

say.text: 找出“瑜伽垫”的低竞争商业意图关键词。
say.note: Claude 会筛选低难度、高商业价值的关键词。

say.text: 分析竞争对手 example.com 的关键词缺口。
say.note: Claude 会对比竞争对手排名关键词，找出你缺失的机会。

howto.what_en: Claude generates keyword lists, classifies by search intent, assesses difficulty, scores opportunities, and produces topic clusters and reports from a seed keyword or niche.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for "find keywords", "keyword research", "search volume", "keyword difficulty", "content ideas from a seed", or similar keyword discovery tasks.

say_en.text: Research keyword opportunities for project management software.
Find low-competition commercial intent keywords for yoga mats.
say_en.note: Claude will filter for low difficulty and high commercial value.

say_en.text: Analyze keyword gaps for competitor example.com.
say_en.note: Claude will compare competitor rankings and identify missing opportunities.
